body:
Search, 14 Nov 2026 (PR #28, branch task/search-local-results-never-wait). Two findings; the first is closed, the second is a real bug found and fixed, but it is NOT proven to be the emulator's 35 s.

1) Do the local results wait for the catalogue? No. Tests (app/test/features/search_local_first_test.dart, whole app, FakeCatalogue.slow()): a catalogue that never answers, and one that answers late: the library's Top result and song are on screen within a second and stay in every frame, no spinner. They pass on main and fail when the page is made to wait for the catalogue (checked by mutation, reverted).

2) A write restarts the search and can starve it (real bug on main since PR #23, N-23a). searchResultsProvider watched artistTypoIndexProvider -> artistsProvider, a drift stream that re-sends the list on EVERY write to artists, albums or tracks, even with the same names; each re-send started the search over, and the first answer of a new query has no earlier value to show. It also watched activeServerProvider, which re-sends whenever the server's row is rewritten. PROOF: a busy phone (every read 40 ms, fake time), a song written through LibraryWriter every 100 ms, "eminem" typed: 31 runs of the search body in 3 s, 30 of them abandoned (logged with a temporary print, reverted); the page stayed empty until the writes stopped. Controls that pass on the old code: nothing written (same slow reads), and writes with reads that answer at once (a search then finishes inside one write). Before #23 the provider watched nothing a write changes. Emulator build 150 predates #23, so this was NOT the cause of the emulator's 35 s; candidates for that remain CPU load and the drift queue, unproven (needs adb/logcat timestamps of a search under load, not done: no device in this task).

FIX (providers.dart): the full-text search is its own provider (_ftsSearchProvider) and watches only the server ID (activeServerIdProvider, emits when the id changes) and the database. searchResultsProvider is now a Provider<AsyncValue<SearchResults>> over it: the FTS answer as soon as it exists, plus the artist typo guess; the artist list is watched only when no artist matched, only there, so a re-send or a late list re-works the guess and never restarts or blocks the search. No change in what the widgets see (still an AsyncValue: add_songs_sheet and SearchResultsView untouched). Typo tests (search_typo_test, artist_typo_test, search_band_first_test) stay green; new test: a list of artists that arrives after the answer still gets its guess and keeps it when re-sent.

KNOWN GAP, same as before #23, not done here: a search left open does not pick up songs that a sync adds afterwards (the old code refreshed only by the accident of the artist list re-sending). A proper answer is a refresh that keeps the last result on screen and is throttled (about once a second) so it does not load a busy phone more; separate task if wanted.
